core_obligations: Verify the vanishing of the four complexes comparing the rings with their (strict) henselizations (proof lines 1905-1907).
Apply the fundamental triangle to A -> B -> B^h to obtain L_{B^h/A} = L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B^h (proof lines 1908-1910).
Apply the fundamental triangle to A -> A^h -> B^h to obtain L_{B^h/A^h} = L_{B^h/A} (proof lines 1911-1912).
Repeat the argument for strict henselizations (proof line 1913).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a local homomorphism of local rings A -> B with induced maps of henselizations and strict henselizations, the cotangent complexes satisfy L_{B^h/A^h} = L_{B^h/A} = L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B^h and the analogous chain for strict henselizations (source lines 1891-1903). The proof observes that the four complexes comparing a ring with its henselization vanish, then applies the fundamental distinguished triangle twice: once for A -> B -> B^h to get L_{B^h/A} = L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B^h, and once for A -> A^h -> B^h to get L_{B^h/A^h} = L_{B^h/A}; the strict henselization case is the same argument.
